values.quote: forming a {{tip|tether}} between himself and the target for 2 seconds
the target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration
values.binNote: No bin row states the 0.5s tick interval directly; it is inferred from the wiki's 4-tick breakdown of the 2-second LeashDuration.
No bin data value carries the 90% slow amount; TooltipFearMS=0.9 is the passive movement speed bonus, not this slow.

mechanics.claim: Unspeakable Horror deals persistent damage over its tether duration, tagged indirect damage, and applies spell effects (on-hit) each tick.
mechanics.quote: ''Unspeakable Horror'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks the tether's application, but not the damage/aftereffects of a tether already applied.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application but not the damage and aftereffects of one already applied.

mechanics.claim: If the tether is not broken by the end of its 2-second duration, the target is feared and slowed by 90%.
mechanics.quote: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is {{tip|fear|feared}} for a duration while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90%.

mechanics.claim: Passively, Nocturne gains bonus movement speed while facing nearby feared targets within a 180° angle.
mechanics.quote: Feared enemies in a {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 180° total angle within '''Nocturne's''' facing direction will trigger ''Unspeakable Horror's'' passive.
